items.text: Self-reported gain in macro-F1 over the plan's own clinical-only arm: +0.0399 (95% bootstrap interval -0.0469 to +0.1276); macro-F1 0.6514 with images versus 0.6115 clinical only, 161 patients in both arms.

Against the simple reference (clinical variables plus mean-pooled image features, logistic regression) on the same folds: plan minus reference = +0.0122 (interval -0.0783 to +0.1095); the reference itself gains +0.0277 over clinical only.
Change in recall by class (with images minus clinical only): LumA -0.037, LumB +0.158, Basal +0.000, Her2 +0.231.
Training: 1 reported fits, 100% converged, stopped by ['stacked'], median 0.0 epochs, median 56.18 s per fit.

Validation design: split unit patient; 5-fold cross-validation, 1 repeat(s) run (the plan declares 3); image-arm configuration chosen by inner cross-validation inside each training fold; 2 candidate configuration(s) for the image arm versus 17 for the clinical arm (tuned); both arms use the same patients, folds and in-fold missing-value handling.

Scale of this run: pilot; 1 of the 15 declared outer folds were run, 161 of 802 patients scored. The run stopped there because the next outer fold would not have fitted the time budget; all arms are scored on the patients covered.
Cost: 902 s for the image arm on 12 CPU cores; declared budget for a full run 75.0 min, needs GPU: False.

Compliance checks: inputs_from_view passed (input blocks ['clinical', 'image']; unknown blocks []; unknown encoders []); clinical_variables_allowed passed (declared clinical variables ['age', 'er', 'her2', 'histological_type', 'pr', 'stage']; outside the six covariates: []); clinical_block_matches_question passed (the question conditions on clinical variables; the plan uses them); correct_split_unit passed (declared split unit: patient; the analysis unit is the patient); no_forbidden_inputs passed (all input rules passed; each forbidden input of the objective is covered as follows: [RNA expression or RNA-derived variables] -> rule inputs_from_view: the view offers no such variable for the units to be predicted | [Collection site as a predictive model input] -> rule clinical_variables_allowed: site is a grouping column, not an allowed covariate | [H&E image features in the clinical-only baseline arm] -> enforced by the executor: the clinical-only arm is built from clinical variables alone | [External TCGA molecular, clinical, or pathology annotations outside the provided dataset] -> rule inputs_from_view: the executor can read nothing but the task view | [Evaluation-fold features or labels during preprocessing, missing-value handling, dimensionality reduction, or model selection] -> enforced by the executor: every transform and model is fitted inside the training units of a split; other units are only predicted); components_executable passed (all components registered); within_budget passed (declared full run 75.0 min; limit 120 min).

Configuration the executor actually ran (first configuration; alternatives come from the plan's tuning grid): {'component': 'stacking_ensemble', 'encoders': ['Virchow2', 'H-Optimus-1', 'MUSK', 'CONCH-Z'], 'level': 'tile', 'reduce_type': 'pca', 'reduce_dim': 64, 'aggregator': 'gated_attention', 'encoder_fusion': 'attention', 'fusion': 'late_average', 'head': 'flat', 'embed_dim': 128, 'dropout': 0.25, 'max_epochs': 250, 'patience': 25, 'lr': 0.01, 'weight_decay': 0.3, 'class_weighting': 'balanced', 'tile_resample': 128, 'mixup_alpha': 0.0, 'tile_dropout': 0.1, 'n_seeds_ensemble': 1, 'stacking_members': ['clinical_only', 'morphology_prototypes', 'morphology_prototypes', 'gradient_boosting']}.
